normalized.result:
The review step feels worth it. It is still quick, and it prevents poor automatically collected details from becoming something I have to fix later. “Discard” also makes backing out clear.

The note formatting is the right level: headings, emphasis, lists, and links cover what I need without making the note editor feel complicated.

When changing an address, keeping my existing title, description, and note is the safer default because they may contain deliberate edits. An optional “Fetch details from new address” action would be useful, but it should never overwrite my text automatically.

I approve the saving and editing behavior. Please move on to search.
